# Skill Balance — status

**GENERATED by `python tools/skill-balance/extract.py` from the saved skill files. Do not edit — the next run
overwrites it.** This is step 1, the simple balance report; the full system is planned in
[Skill Balancing System — Plan](../docs/2-systems/active-skill-system-v3/skill-balancing-system-plan.md). Every
number comes from the same formula the calculator page uses. A skill is **balanced** when what it gives is within
±15% of what it costs, counted in basic attacks. "Balanced" means balanced against the formula, not yet
proven in play.

**Provisional** means the price uses at least one guess about how a fight goes. The guesses, all to be settled by
play-testing:

- being in the right place matters in 50% of a fight (slows, movement speed, dashes); a dash is worth the run it saves at 2 m a second (measured), the whole range when aimed at a spot and half of it when aimed at a target
- an enemy blow takes 5% of your max HP
- an ordinary attack misses 20% of the time; you dodge 20% of enemy blows
- a placed mark is cashed in 50% of the time, for 0.4 of a basic attack
- a kill every 10 s; low health every 30 s; a 2 s disable every 6 s
- flat HP (burn, regen) is measured against an attack of 53 (level 50, before gear); a burn put out has 12 HP left
- a cleanse is worth 0.5 of a basic attack; a second of taunt 0.32

**Extra on top** is growth that needs an investment (a built-up pile, hit chance, speed, max MP) — the base must be
balanced, and the extra is the reward for building into it.

## Price list — basic attack = 1

What one unit of each thing is worth, in basic attacks. A skill's cost is the sum of the first block; what it gives
is the sum of the rest. Where a weapon's swing time matters the worth is given per weapon (Bow 1.1 s, Staff 1.2 s, Sword 1.25 s a
swing), because a second of a buff covers fewer basic attacks on a slower weapon. Bigger amounts scale straight:
+20% for 3 s is 6 times the +10% for 1 s row.

| Thing | One unit | Worth (basic attacks) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **What a skill pays** |  |  |
| Cooldown | 1 s | 0.1 |
| Cooldown of an ultimate | 1 s | 0.075 |
| Mana | 1 MP | 0.0625 |
| Cast time, or the time the skill holds you in place | 1 s | Bow 0.9091 · Staff 0.8333 · Sword 0.8 |
| A passive's allowance | 1 s of fighting | 0.1 |
| **What a skill gives** |  |  |
| Damage | 100% of a basic attack, one hit, one enemy | 1 |
| … landing 8 m or more away | each hit | × 0.85 |
| … a wind-up held to the end | each hit | × 1.5 |
| A hit stopped (a parry charge) | 1 hit | 1 |
| Your next attacks hit harder | +10%, one attack | 0.1 |
| An enemy's next attacks hit softer | −10%, one attack, one enemy | 0.1 |
| Enemy attack speed or accuracy cut (Static too) | −10% for 1 s, one enemy | 0.1 |
| Enemy defence or magic defence cut | −10% for 1 s, one enemy | Bow 0.0909 · Staff 0.0833 · Sword 0.08 |
| Your attack speed or damage up | +10% for 1 s | Bow 0.0909 · Staff 0.0833 · Sword 0.08 |
| Your defence (or magic defence) up | +10% for 1 s | 0.05 |
| Mana drained to you | 1 MP | 0.0625 |
| Your MP regen up | +1 MP a second, for 1 s | 0.0625 |
| **Priced with a guess (provisional)** |  |  |
| Movement speed up, or a slow on an enemy | 10% for 1 s (each enemy, for a slow) | Bow 0.0455 · Staff 0.0417 · Sword 0.04 |
| Dash or teleport | 1 m covered | Bow 0.2273 · Staff 0.2083 · Sword 0.2 |
| Heal as a share of max HP | 10% of max HP | 2 |
| Flat HP: a heal, HP regen, a burn / poison / bleed, their regen cut | 10 HP (each enemy, for damage) | 0.1887 |
| Your accuracy up (stops counting past the miss rate) | +10% for 1 s, up to +20% | Bow 0.0909 · Staff 0.0833 · Sword 0.08 |
| Your evasion up | +10% for 1 s | 0.1 |
| A miss prevented (sure hit) | 1 attack | 0.2 |
| Taunt | 1 s, one enemy | 0.32 |
| Cleanse | one use | 0.5 |
| A mark placed (Chill, copied Chill) | 1 mark, one enemy | 0.2 |
| Marks extended | 1 mark, one enemy | 0.05 |
| Burn put out, payoff | payoff 1, one enemy | 0.2264 |
| Disables turned away | 1 s | 0.3333 |
| Another skill reset, lengthened or given charges | one use | that skill's own cost or worth |

A passive is worth one firing × how often its moment comes, and must match its allowance of 0.1 a second. How often each moment comes, per second of fighting:

| Moment | Times a second |
| --- | --- |
| Each of your basic attacks | Bow 0.9091 · Staff 0.8333 · Sword 0.8 |
| An enemy blow aimed at you | 1 |
| A dodge (guess) | 0.2 |
| A kill (guess) | 0.1 |
| Dropping to low HP (guess) | 0.0333 |

**70 weapon skills:** 30 balanced · 32 balanced provisionally · 0 off budget · 0 partly priced · 8 not priced.
